summary: Frontend-only targeted iteration57 completed on TV web preview (/api/tv-app): deterministic favorites fixture (35 cards), D-pad deep-row scroll, mouse-wheel end reachability, real-station currentStation flow, and mini-player safe-gap geometry across Discover/Genres/GenreList/Favorites were validated.

Keep /api/tv-app URL as canonical browser test entrypoint for TV/Desktop regressions (root URL serves Expo bundling shell).

Verified tvLayout revealTvItem scale math with executable test: 100px physical overflow at scale 0.5 yields 200 scrollTop delta (expected).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed selector is [data-testid^='station-card-']. Confirmed deterministic fixture works when seeded in localStorage then reloaded on /api/tv-app route. Verified final geometry metrics with active currentStation: stageBottom=901, backdropTop=925, gap=24 (button top=958) across Discover/Genres/GenreList/Favorites.
rca_of_issue: Earlier failures were route/harness related: using root preview URL hit Expo bundling shell, and add_init_script alone did not populate favorites in already-open document context. Switching to /api/tv-app and deterministic localStorage seed + reload resolved reproducibility.
